package rulefixtures

// scenario for empty_interface_parameter_overuse: exported functions with `any` or `interface{}` parameters when concrete types would suffice
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.

func ProcessPayload(data any) error {
	switch v := data.(type) {
	case string:
		return handleString(v)
	case int:
		return handleInt(v)
	default:
		return nil
	}
}

func handleString(s string) error { return nil }
func handleInt(i int) error       { return nil }
